endorsements.name: Peerapat Samatathanyakorn
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-12707
endorsements.description: The Library Management System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the 'bid' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query.  This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)

endorsements.label: CVE-2025-14166
endorsements.description: The WPMasterToolKit plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 2.13.0. endorsements.label: CVE-2025-14610
endorsements.description: The TableMaster for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.6.
